privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Kindred is a prototype that helps families coordinate care for someone they love. This page explains, in plain language, what it keeps and why.

stores.title: What Kindred stores
stores.body: Your name and email address, so your Care Circle knows who you are. The tasks, appointments and updates your circle adds, and who did what, so everyone sees the same plan.

google.title: Signing in with Google
google.body: If you continue with Google, Kindred receives only your name, email address and profile picture. It cannot see your Gmail, contacts or calendar. Connecting a calendar is a separate step you choose later.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: Only the members of your Care Circle see your circle's tasks, appointments and updates. Kindred does not sell your information or show ads.

notStored.title: What Kindred doesn't store
notStored.body: Kindred is not a medical record. Please don't add medical details you wouldn't share with your whole circle. There are no passwords to store, because you sign in with Google or a one-time code.

delete.title: Leaving and deleting
delete.body: You can leave your Care Circle at any time, or delete your account. Deleting it removes your name and email. Things you added to a shared circle stay, shown as from a former member.
